product: EXAMPLE: an expense and travel-cost tool for mid-size companies that removes manual receipt handling and DATEV exports. Replace this text with your own product, its buyer and its main benefits.

signals.label: New funding
signals.query: "{name}" (raises OR funding OR "Series A" OR "Series B" OR Finanzierungsrunde OR investment) after:{since}
signals.hint: Fresh money means new budget and growing headcount.

signals.label: Job vacancies: needs written in the ad text
signals.query: "{name}" (jobs OR Stellenangebot OR "we are hiring") (Finance OR Accounting OR Controlling OR Buchhaltung)
signals.hint: Read the ad text for needs: manual processes, tools named, growth, pain words like Excel or month-end close.

signals.label: Government and regulation changes
signals.query: (E-Rechnung OR "e-invoicing" OR GoBD OR Reisekostenrecht) (Pflicht OR Gesetz OR regulation) after:{since}
signals.hint: New obligations that force a process change.

signals.label: Employee voice (reviews)
signals.query: "{name}" (kununu OR glassdoor) (Spesen OR Reisekosten OR expenses OR Bürokratie)
signals.hint: Employees complaining about the process the product fixes.

email_brief: Thank them, mention that colleagues from their company signed up too (no names), explain in three sentences what the product does for their team, offer a 20-minute demo, and end with: Reply STOP to unsubscribe. Write in German for companies in Germany, Austria or Switzerland, otherwise English.
